scripts.text:
[ Ringing Voice ]
Courageous one,
do you wish to return
to your stronghold?
scripts.translation:
[迴響的聲音]
勇士啊，你要返回自己的要塞嗎？

scripts.text:
[ Arunafeltz Royal Edict ]
The Holy Kingdom of
Arunafeltz decrees that
this stronghold is owned
by the ^FF0000{0}^000000 Guild.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯納菲茲王國敕令]
神聖的阿魯納菲茲王國宣佈，此要塞歸^FF0000{0}^000000公會所有。

scripts.text:
[ Schwarzwald Royal Edict ]
The Holy Kingdom of
Schwarzwald decrees that
this stronghold is owned
by the ^FF0000{0}^000000 Guild.
scripts.translation:
[修瓦魯茲巴魯德王國敕令]
神聖的修瓦魯茲巴魯德王國宣佈，此要塞歸^FF0000{0}^000000公會所有。

scripts.text:
[ Arunafeltz Royal Edict ]
The Holy Kingdom of
Arunafeltz declares that
one has yet to claim lordship
over this stronghold. The one
that breaks the Emperium will
be recognized as its new owner.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯納菲茲王國敕令]
神聖的阿魯納菲茲王國宣佈，此要塞尚未有主人。摧毀華麗金屬的人將被認可為新的主人。

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[ Arunafeltz Royal Edict ]
^FF0000{0}^000000 is
Guild Master of ^FF0000{1}^000000.
Any that object must claim this
stronghold through strength of
steel and magic during the
appointed Guild Siege times.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯納菲茲王國敕令]
^FF0000{0}^000000是^FF0000{1}^000000公會的會長。
任何反對者，都必須在公會戰期間以鋼鐵與魔法的力量奪下這座要塞。
